title: EvidenceRestoreService
responsibility: Restores attached records from Git into the local cache after validating every file.

inputs.name: EvidenceRestoreService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root passed unchanged to the verification store, history status, and history note repositories. It determines where restore reads history and writes the local cache; the constructor does not validate it.

outputs.name: EvidenceRestoreService.restore
outputs.description: The resolved summary lists record IDs restored to the local store and attached record IDs skipped during validation. Existing local IDs and empty history add nothing; a record is restored only when it loads without problems and its ID matches the history note.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: restore() can reject with an underlying repository or filesystem error while reading attached evidence or writing the local cache. The service does not catch or translate these failures.
